children: is eyeing a busy October with key events and upgrades in store. At the earliest in October, specifically in the first week, the XRP Seoul event is scheduled for October 3, 2026, at the Grand Hyatt Seoul during Korea Blockchain Week.
executives, including its president Monica Long, RippleX SVP Markus Infanger, and major Korean financial institutions are set to take part in discussions around the future of digital finance.

According to Hussein Zangana (Vet), XRP Ledger Foundation director of community, the upcoming XRP Seoul event will feature sessions with Kyobo Securities, a major Korean securities broker, Woori Bank, one of Korea's top four banks, and Kakao Bank, the country's leading internet bank associated with the popular Kakao platform, with a focus on tokenization, payments on crypto rails, and DeFi.

"Looking forward to XRP Seoul next week and the sessions with Korean securities broker Kyobo Securities, Woori Bank (top 4 bank in Korea), Kakao Bank (largest internet bank of the famous app Kakao here) and many others. All forward leaning in tokenization, payments on crypto rails and DeFi," Vet wrote.

Aside from Ripple President Monica Long and SVP Markus Infanger, the participant lineup for the event is extensive. This includes J.A. Akinyele, RippleX Head of Engineering; Christina Chan, Senior Director of Ecosystem Growth at Ripple; Tatsuya Kohrogi, Senior Ecosystem Growth Manager at Ripple; Wenny Cai, CEO of Anchored Finance; Nicholas Motz, co-founder of Soil; Nathaniel T. Bradley, Datavault AI CEO; Aniket Jindal, Founder of Biconomy; Jinnie Lee, APAC Sales Director at Ripple; Mansik Yoon, Team Leader at Jeonbuk Bank; John Lilic, CSO of Tria; Sunghwan Kim, Founder and CEO of Wellbianlabs; Asheesh Birla, Evernorth CEO; Min Lin, Managing Director of Ondo Finance; Heejin Shin, Executive Director of Kyobo Securities; Hugo Philion, Co-Founder of FlareNetworks; Jaehyuk Choi, TF Lead of Kbank; Bo Kim, CEO of Creder; Leo Lee, Manager of Kakao Bank; Seunghoon Han, Senior Manager of Woori Bank, among others.
XRP Ledger is set for a busy October, with the Batch, fixBatchV1_2, and permissions delegation amendments set to launch in the coming month.

Batch and its fix eye mainnet activation on October 9, while permissions delegation is expected to launch on October 8, 2026, provided they sustain above 80% support for the two-week activation window.
The Swell event is expected to be held October 27–29, 2026, a major event for the XRP and the Ripple ecosystem.

title: Ripple Heads to Seoul: Korea's Banking Giants Set for XRP Spotlight
